_: tools/panel.py resolve(): which lemma a shared form key belongs to, where the rule cannot settle it. Value is the lemma's bare form, or bare|pos when two rows share the spelling. Read by the pool count (build_topics), the lookup index order and the example join (build_site), and the video index (build_transcripts).
_p11.3: Measured over the shipped payload, 2026-09-10. gradeAlignment writes FSRS history through index[key][0], so a form credited to the wrong lemma schedules the wrong word. Counted by reading the English side of every corpus sentence containing the form.
_p11.5: Two rows where the closed-class reading is the word and the content row is a rarity or an inflection: «перед» the preposition against a paradigm-less noun glossed 'before', and «зовут» — a form of «звать» that others.csv carries as a headword of its own.
